package.name: bf_ros_bridge
package.description: MSP <-> ROS bridge for a custom Betaflight fork. Publishes RC, flight status, motor RPM and IMU from MSP replies; subscribes body-rate + thrust (MSP_CTBR, mavros_msgs/AttitudeTarget) and per-motor throttle (MSP_THROTTLE, std_msgs/Float32MultiArray) setpoints and streams them to the flight controller.
